summary.en: Turning kanji into a game of visual recombination. For a Japanese supplementary school class, I broke kanji into components and turned them into a playful recombination puzzle. The goal wasn't to make another worksheet — it was to make kids want to figure it out.
summary.jp: 漢字を、覚えるものから組み立てて遊ぶものへ。補習校のクラスのお楽しみ会のために、漢字をパーツに分解し、組み合わせながら答えを探すパズルゲームをつくった。プリントをもう一枚増やすのではなく、「これ解きたい」と思える形にしたかった。

mine: Decomposed kanji radicals into modular geometric puzzle components
Designed the puzzle rulebook and tactile game sheets for classroom play
Tested and facilitated the game with students at the supplementary school
